text:
sam_sales: heads-up 10x fintech prospect surfaced a 7-year key retention + legal-hold requirement. asking: can Redwood hold an escrow copy? can we offer an unwrap SLA during legal holds? pricing impact?

toni_sre: short answer: we WON'T store plaintext keys. we can support BYOK where keys live in customer's KMS. unwrap SLA depends on deployment: Dedicated/Private = feasible; Hosted = depends on external KMS uptime. :no_entry_sign:

evan_eng: tech detail: we can accept wrapped blobs from customer's KMS and store them as opaque ciphertext (we never unwrap). that's a wrapped-only backup. requires strong access controls, immutable audit, and retrieval workflow.

meera_legal: legal: acceptable if contract says customer retains ownership and gives retrieval authorization process. if Redwood holds wrapped blobs, need SOPs for retrieval and indemnity for compelled disclosure. never agree to plaintext escrow.

am_sales: customer will push to have Redwood act as escrowee and expect price. can we give a placeholder range?

oliver_prod: product viewpoint: label feature as "Managed wrapped key backup" enterprise add-on. pricing model = one-time onboarding + annual compliance surcharge + per-GB encrypted storage + retrieval fee. put "custom quote" in SOW until compliance sign-off.

toni_sre: ops notes: design must use an encrypted object store with HSM-backed encryption for the backup blobs, strict RBAC (no one can decrypt), retrieval approvals logged, and periodic attestation. also include retention lifecycle (auto-delete after retention).

ev an_eng: integration questions to ask the customer now: KMS vendor (AWS KMS/CloudHSM, Azure, Thales), wrapped blob format (CMS/PKCS7/RAW), expected unwrap QPS, rotation cadence, and whether they will provide a test wrapped-blob.

meera_legal: i'll draft clause snippets: (1) "Customer retains sole ownership of keys" (2) "Redwood may store wrapped key blobs only; Redwood will not possess plaintext keying material" (3) "Retrievals require Customer authorization + Redwood retrieval runbook".

s ec_bot: compliance-bot: reminder  run `/new-compliance-review managed-wrapped-backup <prospect-name> <scope:retention+retrieval>` before quoting.

sam_sales: next steps: i'll reply to prospect with a short note: we don't store plaintext; we can offer wrapped-only managed backup as an enterprise add-on (custom quote, requires compliance review); unwrap SLA available for Dedicated/Private with carveouts for customer KMS outages; ask for KMS vendor, endpoints, QPS, rotation cadence, sample wrapped blob. i'll schedule a 30m scoping call.

toni_sre: i'll prepare an ops appendix (latency expectations, caching behavior, retrieval RTO, carveouts).

evan_eng: i'll prepare the integration checklist + minimal test plan: wrap/unwrap smoke, rotation dry-run, retrieval drill.

meera_legal: will circulate contract snippets after scoping call.

sam_sales: scheduled call with prospect for tomorrow 9am PT. posting meeting invite and draft reply after this thread. :thumbsup:
